extracted.name: Banana Chocolate Chip Muffins
extracted.description: These muffins are a new favorite!! They’re so sweet, fluffy, and flavorful and I absolutely love them. Made with simple ingredients (and love, of course), I highly recommend!
ingredient_lines: 1 cup whole wheat or all-purpose flour
Optional: cinnamon, chopped nuts, or dark chocolate chips
instruction_lines: Mash bananas and mix with eggs and sweetener.
Stir in flours, baking soda, salt, and extras.
Spoon into muffin tins and bake 18–22 minutes.
Take out of oven and check if ready with a toothpick. If it’s clean, it’s ready to eat!
Cool down first, or dig right in!
